items.title: Ollie Gordon: Churns out 69 rushing yards in loss
items.text:
Gordon rushed 11 times for 69 yards while catching two of three targets for minus-2 yards in Sunday's 26-9 loss to the Bills.

items.title: Jameson Williams: Long TD grab in win
items.text:
Williams brought in all four targets for 93 yards and a touchdown in the Lions' 31-21 win over the Buccaneers on Sunday.

items.title: Jared Goff: Efficient effort in win
items.text:
Goff completed 20 of 28 passes for 279 yards with two touchdowns and no interceptions while adding five rushes for 12 yards in the Lions' 31-21 win over the Buccaneers on Sunday.

items.title: Josh Johnson: Modest numbers in Week 11 start
items.text:
Johnson completed 18 of 31 passes for 155 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 34-7 loss to Kansas City. he added five yards on two carries.
